---
title: Data
---

All extracted data points, one row per reported statistic. Use the buttons to download.

```{r}
world <- metawoRld::load_metawoRld(".", verbose = FALSE)
DT::datatable(
  world$studies_data,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "Bfrtip",
                 buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"))
)
```
